title: Application to deny sidewalk café in Corona, Queens
summary: The Council disapproved a petition for a revocable consent allowing a sidewalk café with four tables and bench seating at 45-18 104th Street in Corona, Queens. The Department of Transportation had approved the petition on August 18, 2026, but following a September 22, 2026 public hearing, the Council voted on September 24, 2026 to reject it.
